`mcpgen.json` (config format version 1) is the single source of truth of a generated project. This page is generated from `internal/config/schema.json`, the JSON Schema (draft 2020-12) that `mcpgen check` validates against and that `mcpgen schema` embeds.

Top-level required fields: `version`, `server`, `transport`. Unknown fields are rejected (`additionalProperties: false`).

## Complete example

```json
{
  "version": 1,
  "server": {
    "name": "weather",
    "title": "weather",
    "version": "0.1.0",
    "module": "example.com/weather",
    "description": "Generated MCP server.",
    "instructions": "Generated MCP server."
  },
  "transport": {
    "type": "http",
    "httpPort": 8080
  },
  "protocol": "compat",
  "tools": [
    {
      "id": "greet",
      "title": "Greet",
      "description": "Greets a user with a short welcome.",
      "inputSchema": {
        "type": "object"
      },
      "outputSchema": {
        "type": "object"
      },
      "readOnly": true
    }
  ],
  "prompts": [
    {
      "id": "welcome",
      "title": "Welcome",
      "description": "A friendly welcome prompt."
    }
  ],
  "resources": [
    {
      "id": "readme",
      "title": "Readme",
      "description": "A readme stub resource.",
      "uri": "file:///readme",
      "mimeType": "text/plain",
      "text": "Welcome to your MCP server."
    }
  ]
}
```

## Id rules

Tool, prompt, and resource `id` values must match `^[a-zA-Z0-9_-]+$` (letters, digits, underscore, hyphen). Ids become file names and MCP names, so the pattern is enforced before any file is written. Duplicate ids within one kind are rejected.

## Schemas inside the config

`tools[].inputSchema` and `tools[].outputSchema` hold raw JSON Schema documents (draft 2020-12 objects), embedded verbatim into the generated Go code as `json.RawMessage` backtick literals and used by the go-sdk to generate the typed `Input`/`Output` structs of each handler.

## Full JSON Schema

```json
{
  "$schema": "https://json-schema.org/draft/2020-12/schema",
  "$id": "https://github.com/alesr/mcpgen/schema/mcpgen.schema.json",
  "title": "mcpgen project config (mcpgen.json)",
  "description": "Single source of truth for an mcpgen-generated MCP server project. Version 1.",
  "type": "object",
  "required": ["version", "server", "transport"],
  "additionalProperties": false,
  "properties": {
    "version": {
      "type": "integer",
      "const": 1,
      "description": "Config format version. mcpgen v1 supports only 1."
    },
    "server": {
      "type": "object",
      "required": ["name"],
      "additionalProperties": false,
      "properties": {
        "name": { "type": "string", "minLength": 1 },
        "title": { "type": "string" },
        "version": { "type": "string", "description": "SemVer of the server, e.g. 0.1.0" },
        "module": { "type": "string", "minLength": 1, "description": "Go module path" },
        "description": { "type": "string" },
        "instructions": { "type": "string", "description": "Instructions sent to MCP clients" }
      }
    },
    "transport": {
      "type": "object",
      "required": ["type"],
      "additionalProperties": false,
      "properties": {
        "type": { "type": "string", "enum": ["stdio", "http"] },
        "httpPort": { "type": "integer", "minimum": 1, "maximum": 65535 }
      }
    },
    "protocol": {
      "type": "string",
      "enum": ["compat", "latest-only"],
      "default": "compat",
      "description": "compat negotiates down to legacy MCP versions; latest-only serves only 2026-07-28"
    },
    "tools": {
      "type": "array",
      "items": { "$ref": "#/definitions/tool" }
    },
    "prompts": {
      "type": "array",
      "items": { "$ref": "#/definitions/prompt" }
    },
    "resources": {
      "type": "array",
      "items": { "$ref": "#/definitions/resource" }
    },
    "features": {
      "type": "object",
      "additionalProperties": false,
      "properties": {
        "tasks": { "type": "boolean" },
        "skills": { "type": "boolean" },
        "oauth": { "type": "boolean" }
      }
    }
  },
  "definitions": {
    "tool": {
      "type": "object",
      "required": ["id"],
      "additionalProperties": false,
      "properties": {
        "id": { "type": "string", "minLength": 1, "pattern": "^[a-zA-Z0-9_-]+$" },
        "title": { "type": "string" },
        "description": { "type": "string" },
        "inputSchema": { "type": "object", "description": "JSON Schema (draft 2020-12 object) for tool input" },
        "outputSchema": { "type": "object", "description": "JSON Schema (draft 2020-12 object) for structured output" },
        "readOnly": { "type": "boolean", "description": "Maps to the tool readOnlyHint annotation" },
        "idempotent": { "type": "boolean", "description": "Maps to the tool idempotentHint annotation" }
      }
    },
    "prompt": {
      "type": "object",
      "required": ["id"],
      "additionalProperties": false,
      "properties": {
        "id": { "type": "string", "minLength": 1, "pattern": "^[a-zA-Z0-9_-]+$" },
        "title": { "type": "string" },
        "description": { "type": "string" },
        "arguments": {
          "type": "array",
          "items": {
            "type": "object",
            "required": ["name"],
            "additionalProperties": false,
            "properties": {
              "name": { "type": "string", "minLength": 1 },
              "title": { "type": "string" },
              "description": { "type": "string" },
              "required": { "type": "boolean" }
            }
          }
        }
      }
    },
    "resource": {
      "type": "object",
      "required": ["id"],
      "additionalProperties": false,
      "properties": {
        "id": { "type": "string", "minLength": 1, "pattern": "^[a-zA-Z0-9_-]+$" },
        "title": { "type": "string" },
        "description": { "type": "string" },
        "uri": { "type": "string", "description": "Absolute URI. Exactly one of uri/uriTemplate." },

        "mimeType": { "type": "string" },
```
